observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a Yamaha keyboard with a blue control panel and white/black keys, partially wrapped in plastic.
The control panel has a digital display, buttons, and a grid of colored buttons (green, orange, red).
The keyboard appears to be in a retail or store environment, with other products visible in the background.
The seller claims it is 'Very good sound and quality Yamaha keyboard' and 'All keys and buttons working, adapter included. Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.'
No power cord, stand, or accessories are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Very good sound and quality Yamaha keyboard
claims.evidence: Sound quality cannot be assessed from photos; no audio or performance test is shown.
No video or photo shows keys being pressed or buttons being operated. The keyboard is partially wrapped in plastic, so functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.
No adapter is visible in the photos. The seller claims it is included, but it is not shown.

claims.claim: Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not be functional (keys/buttons not working)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing keys being pressed and buttons being operated, with audio output.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, stand, or other components)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.

risks.risk: Keyboard may be damaged or have internal issues (e.g., dead keys, non-responsive buttons)
risks.proof: Close-up video of keys being pressed and buttons being operated, with clear audio feedback.

proof_requests: Video showing all keys and buttons being pressed and operated, with audio output.
Photo of all included accessories (power adapter, stand, etc.).
Close-up of the control panel and keys to check for damage or wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
